737:t_014:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The $$黒い太陽#sol$$, $$ヘリオース$$, and $$プロディキウム$$... Through this trinity, the eight $$スフィア$$s, and the four eternal souls, the Supreme God will be reborn!」

737:t_014:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And the Heavenly Prison will be destroyed, and a new universe will begin!」

737:t_015:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Th-this is bad! Everyone, please return immediately!」

737:t_100:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$セツコ$$. It gives me joy to be able to welcome you like this.」

737:t_100:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you, too, make contact with me to awaken me as a $$スフィア・リアクター$$?」

737:t_100:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly. And that... bears fruit today.」

737:t_100:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now, $$セツコ$$... give me that power.」

737:t_100:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$スフィア$$... Because of them, so many people's fates have been twisted...」

737:t_100:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But that ends today! Everyone, defeat the $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_100:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That wish will not be granted. Because I am here.」

737:t_101:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've finally cornered you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

737:t_101:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Ever since $$翠の地球$$, you've been deceiving us! I can't forgive that!」

737:t_101:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have never lied to you. You were chosen to save the universe together with me.」

737:t_101:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you mean become a $$真徒$$, no thanks! Don't think you can keep us as pets!」

737:t_101:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「The ties between you and us end here! Get ready, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

737:t_101:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That fire... As I thought, you are $$ザ・ヒート$$... the very man I seek.」

737:t_102:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If it was going to come to this, I should've looked into that uneasy feeling I got at the start.」

737:t_102:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you saying it would have been better to fight me on $$翠の地球$$?」

737:t_102:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Thinking it over calmly, I don't think we'd have been any match for you back then.」

737:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Looking at what you must do with calm eyes and judging for yourself... It seems your unbreakable will is finally complete.」

737:t_102:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't talk like you know me! I'm $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ before I'm a Reactor!」

737:t_102:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I make it a rule to pay back what I owe! Time for full repayment, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

737:t_102:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, $$クロウ$$. I will meet your will head-on.」

737:t_103:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So this day has come...」

737:t_103:2.en:
$n
「Did you really think you could win me over?」

737:t_103:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There was no need for that. You should have been mine all along.」

737:t_103:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... your family, and your fate.」

737:t_103:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What kind of person are you...!」

737:t_103:6.en:
$n
「It's all right, Miss $$スズネ$$... What he's saying isn't wrong...」

737:t_103:8.en:
$n
「But from here on, it's different! I'll show him I can go beyond what he has planned!」

737:t_103:9.en:
$n
「And then I'll avenge Dad, Mom, and Sis!」

737:t_103:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I wonder if you can really do it.」

737:t_103:11.en:
$n
「I will! That's what I've been fighting for all the way to today!!」

737:t_103:12.en:
$n
「This is the end, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll surpass you!!」

737:t_104:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Bring it, $$御使い$$s! I'll take you down here and end this war!」

737:t_104:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Oh, this is hilarious! Thinking you can actually win!」

737:t_104:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Ignorance is sin...! Sinners must be punished! That is our mission!」

737:t_104:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「How many lives have you taken with that selfish logic of yours!?」

737:t_104:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'm not $$サクリファイ$$, you know. I don't keep count of stuff like that.」

737:t_104:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't forgive you! Human lives aren't your toys!」

737:t_104:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Get ready! Me and $$ザンボット３$$ will crush you with everything we've got!!」

737:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「This universe has no need for an arrogant ruler!」

737:t_105:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「There is no evolution in a universe without order. In wrath, I shall reign over humanity.」

737:t_105:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ does it because it's fun, though!」

737:t_105:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is exactly the arrogance I'm talking about! You have no right to do as you please with humanity's evolution or its lives!」

737:t_105:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This is a duty! The duty of us, the $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_105:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Anyone who can't understand that should just die!」

737:t_105:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「It is you who will perish, $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_105:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me and $$ダイターン３$$! Your $$黒い太陽#sol$$ will be shattered by us!!」

737:t_106:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This is hilarious! A tiny president of a tiny company, coming to a place like this without knowing his place!」

737:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I don't want to hear that from a brat who's lived a hundred million years and never grown up!」

737:t_106:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are eternal beings. We are filled with knowledge and power that the likes of you cannot fathom.」

737:t_106:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If someone that great loses to a tiny company's tiny president, that'll be a real masterpiece!」

737:t_106:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Does this one, too, require punishment!」

737:t_106:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Shut up! If we did something wrong, we'll take our punishment, but we're just doing our best to live!」

737:t_106:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Neither me nor $$トライダー$$ will lose to anyone who decides on their own that that's evil!!」

737:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$! Break through the fortress and destroy that $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

737:t_107:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Useless, useless! Even if they call you the Messenger of the Sun, a puny power like that can't do it!」

737:t_107:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Right now, $$鉄人$$ and I are one! That power won't lose to any enormous evil!」

737:t_107:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So that's the so-called $$真化融合$$...」

737:t_107:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「In that case, I will teach you how powerless you are! By destroying that puppet, which is as good as your very self!」

737:t_107:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't flinch, $$鉄人$$! You're a warrior of steel!」

737:t_107:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Our enemy is the greatest villain in the universe! We'll defeat them with our power and bring peace to the universe!!」

737:t_108:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It was a mistake for mere humans to obtain the power of light!」

737:t_108:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's what they call pearls before swine!」

737:t_108:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$マジンガー$$ is the hope Grandpa left behind for me!」

737:t_108:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「And by becoming one with $$マジンガー$$, I'll turn Photon Power into the power of hope!」

737:t_108:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This one...! Is he trying to draw out the very essence of the power of light through $$真化融合$$!?」

737:t_108:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Get ready, $$御使い$$s! My body is brimming with power like never before!」

737:t_108:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll defeat evil and carry hope on into the future! For that mission, $$マジンガー$$ and I will fight!!」

737:t_109:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You have set foot not only in the $$カオス・コスモス$$ but even in this $$エス・テラン$$. You must be punished.」

737:t_109:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Do you think threats like that will work on us now?」

737:t_109:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We've grown strong. Far stronger than when we left Earth.」
